headlines.title: 8月新增信贷与社融预计环比回升 但低于去年同期
headlines.summary: 近日对14家境内外机构的调查显示，受访经济学家对2026年8月新增人民币贷款的预测均值约为3820亿元，预计较2025年同期少增2080亿元，但环比7月的-3400亿元将明显好转；预测区间为100亿元至6000亿元。8月仍然是信贷投放的季节性“小月”，并且多数受访机构认为2026年8月新增人民币信贷规模不会超过去年同期。中金公司宏观研究报告指出，尽管相关部门对票据转贴现业务监管加强，8月票据利率仍然在地位徘徊、月末未见抬升，显示贷款需求偏弱背景下，银行直贴票据冲刺贷款指标的诉求仍然较强，因而判断8月信贷仍然弱于去年同期。中金公司预计8月新增人民币贷款27

headlines.title_en: August new credit and aggregate financing expected to rebound month-on-month but stay below year-earlier levels
headlines.summary_en: A recent survey of 14 domestic and foreign institutions shows that the average forecast by surveyed economists for new RMB loans in August 2026 is about 382 billion yuan, expected to be 208 billion yuan less than the same period in 2025, but a marked improvement from -340 billion yuan in July; the forecast range is 10 billion yuan to 600 billion yuan. August is still a seasonal "small month" for credit extension, and most surveyed institutions believe that the scale of new RMB credit in August 2026 will not exceed the same period last year. A CICC macroeconomic research report pointed out that despite strengthened regulatory oversight of bill rediscounting business by relevant authorities, bill rates still hovered at low levels in August and did not rise at month-end, indicating that against the backdrop of weak loan demand, banks still have a strong desire to use direct bill discounting to meet loan targets, and therefore judges that August credit remained weaker than the same period last year. headlines.title: 30年期美债拍卖在即 特朗普派现承诺加剧债市不安
headlines.summary: 特朗普承诺若共和党赢得中期选举将给全国民众每人发放5000美元，这在美国30年期国债拍卖前给债券市场注入了新的不确定性，重新引发了对美国财政纪律和决策反复无常的担忧。在特朗普作出承诺后，美债收益率在窄幅区间内波动。特朗普对此并未提供细节，该提议预计不太可能成为法律。特朗普发表上述言论之际，30年期美债收益率正接近全球金融危机以来最高水平。此前美政府计划单次购买最多60亿美元较长期国债，令部分市场投资者感到失望。目前所有目光都集中在周四将发行的220亿美元2056年到期国债，以及本周晚些时候公布的CPI数据上。

headlines.title_en: 30-year US Treasury auction imminent; Trump's cash payout pledge intensifies bond market unease
headlines.summary_en: Trump promised that if Republicans win the midterm elections he will give every American $5,000, injecting new uncertainty into the bond market ahead of the U.S. 30-year Treasury auction and reigniting concerns about U.S. fiscal discipline and erratic policymaking. After Trump made the promise, U.S. Treasury yields fluctuated within a narrow range. Trump provided no details, and the proposal is expected to be unlikely to become law. Trump made the remarks as the 30-year Treasury yield approached its highest level since the global financial crisis. Earlier, the U.S. government's plan to buy up to $6 billion of longer-term Treasuries in a single operation disappointed some market investors. All eyes are now on Thursday's $22 billion auction of Treasuries maturing in 2056, and on CPI data due later this week.

headlines.title: 国家发展改革委举行与美在华企业高层圆桌会
headlines.summary: 今天（9月10日）上午，国家发展改革委与美在华跨国企业高层圆桌会在京举办，主题为“拥抱‘十五五’ 共谋新发展”。亚马逊云、英伟达、戴尔、霍尼韦尔（中国）有限公司等60余家来自科技算力、工业能源和消费医药等领域美在华企业代表参会。会上，国家发展改革委相关司局介绍“十五五”规划纲要有关政策考虑，“十五五”时期我国利用外资政策情况，新一轮大规模设备更新和消费品以旧换新政策有关实施成效，提振消费相关政策精神，相关负责人介绍发展北京市经济社会发展情况并推介北京市投资环境，跨国企业高层代表发言交流。（央视财经）

headlines.title_en: National Development and Reform Commission holds high-level roundtable with US companies in China
headlines.summary_en: This morning (September 10), the National Development and Reform Commission and senior executives of U.S. multinational companies in China held a roundtable in Beijing under the theme "Embracing the '15th Five-Year Plan' and Pursuing New Development Together." More than 60 representatives of U.S. companies in China, including Amazon Cloud, Nvidia, Dell, and Honeywell (China) Co., Ltd., from fields such as technology and computing power, industrial energy, and consumer and pharmaceuticals, attended the meeting. At the meeting, relevant departments of the National Development and Reform Commission introduced policy considerations related to the outline of the "15th Five-Year Plan," the situation of China's foreign investment utilization policies during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, the implementation results of the new round of large-scale equipment upgrading and consumer goods trade-in policies, and the spirit of policies related to boosting consumption. Relevant officials introduced Beijing's economic and social development situation and promoted Beijing's investment environment, and senior representatives of multinational companies spoke and exchanged views. (CCTV Finance)

headlines.summary: 据知情人士透露，印度将推动金砖国家扩大使用央行数字货币进行跨境支付，但不会支持可能被视为挑战美元的统一支付网络。知情人士称，随着印度今年担任金砖国家轮值主席国，印度总理莫迪倾向于使用央行数字货币结算成员国之间的双边贸易。知情人士表示，本周末在新德里举行的领导人峰会上不太可能就单一的金砖国家支付结算系统达成协议。

headlines.title_en: India said to favor using central bank digital currency in BRICS payments
headlines.summary_en: A person familiar with the matter said India will push BRICS to expand the use of central bank digital currencies for cross-border payments, but will not support a unified payment network that could be seen as challenging the dollar. The person said that as India holds the BRICS rotating presidency this year, Indian Prime Minister Modi favors using central bank digital currencies to settle bilateral trade among member states. The person said an agreement on a single BRICS payment settlement system is unlikely to be reached at the leaders' summit in New Delhi this weekend.

As of the midday close, the Hang Seng Index was down 1.29% in the morning session, the Hang Seng Tech Index was down 2.07%, and Hong Kong's main board turnover was HK$105.86 billion. headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 10 — The China Association of Automobile Manufacturers today released August automobile production and sales data. China's leading position in new energy vehicles continued to consolidate, becoming the key incremental driver stabilizing the overall industry. The latest data show that the monthly share of new energy vehicle sales hit a new high. headlines.summary_en: The China Association of Automobile Manufacturers released data on the 10th showing that in August 2026, China's production and sales of new energy vehicles reached 1.653 million and 1.643 million units, respectively, both up nearly 20% year-on-year. headlines.title: 深圳市地方金融管理局副局长朱江：用足用好前海、河套政策平台，纵深推进深港金融合作
headlines.summary: 9月10日，由证券时报社主办的“2026金融机构年会”在深圳举行。深圳市地方金融管理局副局长朱江在致辞时表示，深圳连通世界，是新时代全面深化改革、扩大开放的窗口，希望各金融机构用足用好前海、河套等重大政策平台，纵深推进深港金融合作，在跨境人民币、跨境结算、跨境理财通方面先行先试。他介绍，目前深港之间有八个不同互联互通机制，发展态势良好。朱江表示，深圳金融业处在大有可为的战略机遇期，诚挚期待与各界携手并肩、同向同行，共同书写金融高质量发展新篇章。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: Zhu Jiang, deputy director of the Shenzhen Local Financial Supervision and Administration Bureau: Make full use of the Qianhai and Hetao policy platforms to deepen Shenzhen-Hong Kong financial cooperation
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, the "2026 Financial Institutions Annual Conference," hosted by Securities Times, was held in Shenzhen. Zhu Jiang, deputy director of the Shenzhen Local Financial Regulatory Bureau, said in his speech that Shenzhen connects to the world and is a window for comprehensively deepening reform and expanding opening-up in the new era. He hoped that financial institutions would fully and effectively use major policy platforms such as Qianhai and Hetao, deepen Shenzhen-Hong Kong financial cooperation, and pilot initiatives in cross-border RMB, cross-border settlement, and Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect. He noted that there are currently eight different connectivity mechanisms between Shenzhen and Hong Kong, all developing well. Zhu Jiang said Shenzhen's financial industry is in a period of strategic opportunity with much to accomplish, and sincerely looked forward to joining hands with all sectors and moving forward together to write a new chapter in high-quality financial development. (Securities Times)
